item.description:
Import your X bookmarks, properly

  • X bookmark setup is back. Settings → Data now walks you through it: a How does this work? guide (get the extension → bookmark on X → import your history) and an Import my bookmarks… button that pulls in up to 400 of your existing X bookmarks.

X bookmark sync is here

  • The browser extension is live. Carpet — X Bookmark Sync is now on the Chrome Web Store. Settings → Data has a new Get the extension button to install it and start syncing your X bookmarks straight into Carpet.

Dropped images from the web now stick

  • Web image drops are fixed. Dragging a picture straight out of Safari, Chrome, or another browser onto the notch now reliably saves the image itself — instead of quietly doing nothing, or filing away the page link in its place.

A fresh welcome, launch at login, and a calmer Carpet

  • Reworked onboarding. A new four-screen intro walks you through the loop — drop things in, ask for them back, and find them already sorted — with all-new artwork drawn straight from the notch.
  • Launch at login. Carpet can now start automatically when you log in to your Mac, so your vault is always a glance away. Turn it on during setup or anytime in Settings.
  • Smoother and steadier. Fixed the image-memory pressure that could freeze the app, and moved heavy work off the main thread so the notch and library stay responsive.

Light mode, inline notes, sharper search

  • Light & dark themes. A new sun/moon switch beside the gear flips Carpet between a soft paper-white light theme and the original dark — your pick sticks. Dark stays the default, and the notch stays dark in both.
  • Edit notes in place. Notes now open and edit right inside the library card — no more modal. Press ⌘N (or use the notch) to start a new note as a focused card at the top of the grid.
  • Sharper search. Results are keyword-authoritative, with on-device semantics used only to re-rank — so what you type is what you find.
